subject: APAC/EU capacity ask — NovaHealth pilot & Q4 pool prioritization
messages:
From: Kate Morris <kate@novahealth.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:12:00Z
Subject: Dedicated pool request for APAC + EU pilot

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team loved the latency consistency. We want to kick off a small pilot targeting hospitals in Singapore and Germany in Q4. High-level profile: 3k monthly active users at peak (expected 120 concurrent sessions at peak hour), interactive chat using a 70B instruction-tuned model variant, average response length ~120 tokens, and 95th percentile latency target <= 400ms.

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood provision a dedicated pool scoped to APAC (Singapore) and EU (Frankfurt) for the pilot window (2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31)?
- Rough sizing guidance (GPU count / expected sustained RPS) and an initial cost ballpark so we can prepare procurement.
- Any lead time you need to reserve capacity and typical PO timelines for Dedicated.

We may also want burst capacity during the first two weeks of rollout. Timeline is tight — can you send a mutual action plan and a short checklist we can circulate?

Appreciate it —
Kate Morris
Head of AI Product, NovaHealth
kate@novahealth.ai

P.S. Procurement is cc'd on this thread.

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Kate Morris <kate@novahealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool request for APAC + EU pilot

Hi Kate — great to hear the demo resonated. Putting an initial plan below and attaching a short mutual action plan template (NovaHealth-MAP-template.pdf).

Quick sizing assumptions (ballpark):
- APAC (Singapore): provisionally 6 A100-equivalent GPUs (can sustain ~100 concurrent sessions on 70B with batching, expected sustained throughput ~45 tps for typical prompt sizes).
- EU (Frankfurt): provisionally 3 A100-equivalent GPUs (sustain ~50 concurrent sessions).
- Burst option: +2 GPUs in APAC for the first 2 weeks; fall back to hosted endpoints if burst capacity is exhausted.
- Latency target: we should be able to achieve ~350ms p95 with continuous batching + prefix caching for your traffic profile.

Est. committed monthly cost (very rough): APAC pool: $58k/month; EU pool: $28k/month. Exact numbers depend on committed hours and model quantization. PO lead time: 2–3 weeks to lock Dedicated pool once contract and payment terms are agreed; infra provisioning lead time can be 3–6 weeks for new region availability depending on partner datacenter windows.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Fill out the attached MAP with launch dates and expected traffic ramp (procurement included).
2) Confirm whether burst is required and whether you want on-demand fallbacks.
3) Internal prioritization — we have two other mid‑market pilots targeting APAC in the same quarter; I’ll loop in our capacity owners for a tradeoff decision.

Sending to Marissa and Karthik to give an allocation recommendation based on existing commitments.

— Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T14:45:00Z
Subject: Fwd: APAC/EU capacity ask — NovaHealth pilot & Q4 pool prioritization

Team — forwarding Kate's note and my reply. High level asks below plus a quick capacity calc attached (capacity_calc_v1.xlsx). Please reply with feasibility and prioritization callouts.

Summary / asks:
- Timebox: pilot window 2026-10-01 -> 2026-12-31.
- Provisional sizing (my ask to infra): APAC 6 A100-eq, EU 3 A100-eq, burst +2 APAC first two weeks.
- Risk: we have an overlapping pipeline item (MediScale, DL-79001) that also requests APAC capacity for a longer-term POC starting 2026-09. MediScale has slightly higher ARR upside but longer legal cycles.

Preliminary capacity note (from my calc): 1 A100-eq can support ~18–20 concurrent sessions on the 70B variant with target latency assuming aggressive batching. So 6 GPUs -> ~110–120 concurrent. These are roughs and assume model quantization to int8 and prefix caching for common prompts.

Options for prioritization:
A) Provisional carve: APAC 6 / EU 3 for NovaHealth; convert to 8/4 when PO signed. Hold MediScale until NovaHealth PO returns.
B) Split APAC pool: allocate 4 to NovaHealth and 4 to MediScale; smaller pilot for both, upsell later.
C) Push NovaHealth to use hosted fallback for burst weeks and allocate fewer Dedicated GPUs initially (APAC 4 / EU 2).

Operational constraints:
- New region reservations (Singapore) may require partner lead time ~4 weeks to confirm rack-level availability; need ops to start a provisioning ticket ASAP if we go with option A.
- Contracting: finance will need standard Dedicated commitment terms; procurement may request a 90-day runway for PO submission.

Requesting your take: marissa, can you OK provisional carve or do we need to preserve capacity for MediScale? Karthik — any pricing concessions you want me to surface to expedite NovaHealth PO? Lauren — please flag SRE/ops contact and expected provisioning timeline for new Singapore pool.

Thanks —
Priyom

Thanks for the write up, Priyom. I ran the numbers with capacity planning and finance. Given the higher probability of NovaHealth closing quickly (procurement already engaged) and the relatively short pilot window, I approve a provisional carve for APAC 6 / EU 3 with the following caveats:

- This is a provisional allocation effective immediately. We will convert to the committed 8 / 4 split only after we receive a signed PO by 2026-08-15.
- Ops: please open provisioning ticket for Singapore now and target a soft reserve (rack hold) — tag: "NovaHealth_Q4_pilot". Expect confirmation in 3–4 weeks.
- Pricing: Karthik, please prepare a PO-ready quote with the provisional prices Priyom outlined and include a one-time activation credit for the first month (to help procurement).
- Communicate to Kate that burst will be handled via hosted fallback if we exhaust the provisional pool during the first two weeks.

Priyom — I'll let you draft the MAP with these dates and cc ops once the provisioning ticket is created. Let's aim to have procurement terms on the table by 2026-07-30 so NovaHealth can review before the end of July.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
